meta.title: Source conflict register
meta.rule: When two sources give different values for the same measure and period, both are shown. We never average them or pick a winner without evidence. Explanations below are hypotheses, labelled as such, until a reviewer confirms them against the original pages.
meta.reviewed: Not yet reviewed by a subject specialist

values.label: Budget financing table (own-source target)
Implied by the stated 47 per cent (436.68 / 0.47)
Same report, Table 2.1 (own-source revenue of all 47 counties), Siaya total target: ordinary 643.39 plus FIF/A-i-A 283.95 (PDF p. 46, printed p. 3, RapidOCR)

conflicts.definitions: KSh 436.68m collected against 1,043m would be 41.9 per cent, but the report states 47 per cent. Table 2.1 gives a total target of 927.34 million and prints 47 per cent, which is 436.68 of 927.34 (47.1 per cent).

conflicts.measure: Own-source revenue collected, FY 2024/25 (county statement versus Controller of Budget)

values.label: Controller of Budget FY 2024/25 report, Table 2.1, Siaya total own-source revenue including facility improvement financing (PDF p. 46, printed p. 3, OCR); 47 per cent of a 927.34 target
County government statement reported by Kenya News Agency, 20 September 2025 (KSh 946,893,440.40 against a KSh 1,044,061,306 target)

County Treasury, Budget Implementation Report for the 4th quarter of FY 2024/25, Table 4, Total OSR row (PDF p. 6, printed Page 6 of 8; also Table 2, PDF p. 3; read from the text layer, not OCR): KSh 757,570,621 against KSh 1,044,061,306

conflicts.definitions: Kenya News Agency (20 September 2025) reports that, according to the county government, "the county collected Sh946,893,440/40 against an annual revenue target of Sh1,044,061,306", and quotes the statement: "This translates to 90.6% performance and not 47% as reported by the controller of budget". The fifteen revenue streams listed in the article add up exactly to KSh 946,893,440.40; KSh 643,174,553 of it is hospital fees and the other streams total KSh 303,718,887.40. The Controller of Budget figure of KSh 436.68 million is ordinary own-source revenue of KSh 236.84 million plus facility improvement financing, against a target of KSh 927.34 million (ordinary 643.39 plus FIF/A-i-A 283.95). The county’s own fourth-quarter report gives KSh 757,570,621: KSh 236,502,391 into the County Revenue Fund and KSh 521,068,230 as appropriations-in-aid, mostly health receipts. It states 68 per cent of target; 757.57 of 1,044.06 is 72.6 per cent. 946.89 of 1,044.06 is 90.7 per cent. Part by part (calculated by Takwimu, /counties/siaya/analysis/#an-a8, records SIA-A8-2024-25-difference-*): ordinary own-source revenue is KSh 236.50 million in the county Q4 report against 236.84 in Controller of Budget Table 2.1 (-0.34), and FIF/A-i-A (hospital and health facility receipts) is 521.07 against 199.84 (+321.23). The difference between the two totals (320.89) lies in FIF/A-i-A, which is lawful own-source revenue under the Facility Improvement Financing Act, 2023.
conflicts.hypothesis: Possible basis mismatch, not yet established. (1) Facility improvement financing: the ordinary revenue figures are close (236.50 in the county report, 236.84 in the Controller of Budget table), so the gap sits mainly in hospital and health-insurance receipts, which each source may count differently (for example receipts retained at facilities, SHA/SHIF or capitation payments). (2) Target definition: the county uses KSh 1,044,061,306 (its budget, including appropriations-in-aid), the Controller of Budget table uses KSh 927.34 million. (3) Period: the statement may count receipts recorded after the fourth-quarter report or arrears; the Controller of Budget report notes KSh 290 million of arrears in the total. The county statement says its figures were submitted to the Auditor-General; the audited financial statements for FY 2024/25 would settle the basis.
conflicts.effect: Nothing changes in the series: the ten-year own-source revenue trend and the Siaya hub headline keep the Controller of Budget value 436.68. The county statement and the county report are listed here and in the Siaya hub own-source revenue chart (data/siaya.json observations), side by side, so readers can see the difference. Takwimu draws no conclusion about which figure is right.
